display.purpose: Page titles - one per screen (Purchase Orders, Welcome back).

headline.purpose: Section headers inside a page or modal.

title.purpose: Sub-section labels, stat-tile values, dialog titles.

body.purpose: The workhorse - table cells, form fields, descriptions. Compact by default.

label.purpose: Captions, stat-tile labels, helper text, breadcrumbs. Sentence case.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: The only ambient shadow: interactive cards on hover, paired with a border darken. Dark scheme uses rgba(0,0,0,0.4).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (box-shadow, border-color, background).

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: State transitions sit in the 150-250ms band; they convey state, never choreography.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: The default action button (e.g. Create PO). Shop Amber fill, ink text.

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffca28; color: #212121; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ffb300; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #212121; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #ffa000; }

components.name: Primary (Ink) Button
components.description: Structural or confirm actions. Ink fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #212121; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #424242; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #212121; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Lower-priority and inline row actions. Ink border and text on transparent.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #212121; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 20px; border: 1px solid #212121; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(33,33,33,0.06); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #212121; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact status marker on rows (e.g. PO status). Primary chip is ink; status meaning comes from the status color set, not the accent.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #212121; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.description: Compact dashboard KPI tile: icon + value + label. Flat, bordered, shares width evenly (flex 1 1 0). Never a gradient hero-metric.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: MUI outlined small text field. Hairline stroke, 8px radius, floating label doubles as the empty-state placeholder.
components.css: .ds-field { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #616161; } .ds-field-input { font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #212121; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.23); border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; transition: border-color 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #212121; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #212121; border-width: 2px; padding: 7px 11px; }

components.description: The operational table's tinted sticky header. Borderless grid, header reads via a tint rather than a divider line.

narrative.overview: UC Nexus is one continuous lifecycle - TITAN import, purchase orders, warehouse receiving, shop assembly, shipping - and every module draws from a single MUI theme: one font, one palette, one 8px radius, one component set. The visual language never changes station to station. What changes is density and rhythm, and only that. The character is efficient, precise, and industrial - a dependable shop tool, not a consumer app. Near-black ink carries structure and primary actions; a single Shop Amber accent marks the one thing that matters on a screen. Surfaces are flat and bordered, not shadowed. Components should feel solid and dependable - built to take the same task performed dozens of times a day.
keyCharacteristics: One shared theme across every module; density varies, vocabulary does not.
Near-black ink + a single Shop Amber accent; accent on roughly 10% of a screen, never decoration.
Flat and bordered by default; elevation appears only as a response to state.
One humanist sans (Source Sans 3) at a fixed rem scale, bold headings, no display faces in UI.
Every region earns its space; the viewport never scrolls sideways.
Full light and dark schemes, WCAG 2.1 AA.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Shop Amber marks at most one primary thing per screen - the main action or the current selection, at roughly 10% coverage. If two amber elements compete, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Success/warning/error/info hues are reserved for real system state. Color that can mean status must only ever mean status.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed rem values, never clamp()/fluid. A heading that shrinks inside a sidebar reads as broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Source Sans 3 carries everything. Hierarchy comes from weight and size alone; no display or secondary family enters the UI.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat when idle. A shadow is feedback, never decoration.

dos: Do keep one shared vocabulary across modules - same button, chip, input, and table styles everywhere.
Do spend Shop Amber on one thing per screen (the primary action or current selection), at roughly 10% coverage.
Do keep surfaces flat and bordered at rest; let shadow appear only on hover or in dialogs.
Do use fixed rem type sizes and the single Source Sans 3 family; build hierarchy from weight and size.
Do size every region to its content and let one flexible element absorb the slack - in master-detail, collapse the list to a rail and give the detail the width.
Do ship every interactive state (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading) and use skeletons for loading, not centered spinners.
Do reserve success/warning/error/info strictly for real system state (relay, GP sync, validation).
donts: Don't make it look like consumer / playful SaaS - no rounded-everything, no colorful marketing gloss, no oversized empty hero sections.
Don't sprawl - no short values stretched across empty columns, no panel sprawling vertically while starved horizontally.
Don't slide into legacy enterprise clutter - no gray-on-gray, cramped, inconsistent old-ERP density with no hierarchy.
Don't add flashy or heavy motion - no gradients-as-decoration, no bounce or elastic, no orchestrated page-load sequences.
Don't let the viewport scroll sideways - a component may scroll inside its own bounded container, but the page never widens.
Don't build a gradient hero-metric tile; stat tiles stay compact, bordered, and flat.
Don't reach for a modal first - exhaust inline and progressive-disclosure alternatives before overlaying the flow.
Don't introduce a second font family or a display face into UI labels, buttons, or data.
